description: A script for generating OpenGL dispatch tables and NULL bindings for ANGLE, involving parsing XML and JSON data, and generating C++ header and source files.

classes.name: DispatchTableGL
classes.description: Class defining the OpenGL dispatch table with methods to initialize function pointers based on version and extensions.

methods.name: safe_append
methods.description: Utility to append an element to a list in a dictionary, creating the list if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: first_lower
methods.description: Converts the first character of a string to lowercase.

methods.name: format_ep_decl
methods.description: Formats an entry point declaration line for the dispatch table.

methods.name: format_requirements_lines
methods.description: Generates code lines for function pointer assignments based on version requirements.

methods.name: format_extension_requirements_lines
methods.description: Generates code lines for extension-based function pointer assignments.

methods.name: assign_null_line
methods.description: Replaces function pointer assignment with NULL stub for null functions.

methods.name: assign_null
methods.description: Applies assign_null_line to all lines in a dispatch table entry.

methods.name: nullify
methods.description: Converts a list of dispatch table entries to their NULL counterparts.

methods.name: format_param
methods.description: Formats a parameter's text from XML.
